p1: If those dishes rattle... you die.
He'd shine a flashlight in your eyes, make you lie face down, and stack dishes on your back.
Then he'd walk through your house. Listening.
From 1976 to 1986, he broke into more than 100 homes across California.
He attacked dozens of people. He killed 13.
In 2018, detectives uploaded his DNA to a family-tree website.
It led them to a relative... then to one man. 72 years old.
Living in Citrus Heights. Where some of his first attacks happened.
They pulled a tissue from his trash. It matched.
And when the attacks began... he was a police officer.
His name is Joseph DeAngelo. The Golden State Killer.
He pleaded guilty to 13 murders. He'll die in prison.
But for 32 years... he was just the old man next door.
